answer_text:
Let  
\[
p=2017,\qquad f(x)=x^3-x-1.
\]
The product is over all residue classes modulo \(p\), so modulo \(p\) we need
\[
P\equiv \left(\prod_{a\in \mathbb F_p} f(a)\right)^2.
\]

Since the remainder is given to be nonzero, no factor \(f(a)\) is \(0\bmod p\). Thus \(f\) has no root in \(\mathbb F_p\). A cubic with no root over a field is irreducible, so \(f\) is irreducible over \(\mathbb F_p\).

Let \(\alpha\) be a root of \(f\) in an algebraic closure. Because \(f\) is irreducible of degree \(3\), the Frobenius map \(x\mapsto x^p\) cycles its three roots:
\[
\alpha,\quad \alpha^p,\quad \alpha^{p^2}.
\]

For any element \(\beta\),
\[
\prod_{a\in\mathbb F_p}(a-\beta)=\beta-\beta^p,
\]
since
\[
\prod_{a\in\mathbb F_p}(\beta-a)=\beta^p-\beta
\]
and \(p\) is odd.

Therefore, if
\[
A=\prod_{a\in\mathbb F_p} f(a),
\]
then
\[
A=(\alpha-\alpha^p)(\alpha^p-\alpha^{p^2})(\alpha^{p^2}-\alpha).
\]
Squaring,
\[
A^2=(\alpha-\alpha^p)^2(\alpha^p-\alpha^{p^2})^2(\alpha^{p^2}-\alpha)^2,
\]
which is exactly the discriminant of \(f\).

For \(f(x)=x^3+ax+b\), the discriminant is
\[
\Delta=-4a^3-27b^2.
\]
Here \(a=-1,\ b=-1\), so
\[
\Delta=-4(-1)^3-27(1)=4-27=-23.
\]
Thus
\[
P\equiv A^2\equiv -23 \pmod{2017}.
\]
Since
\[
-23\equiv 2017-23=1994\pmod{2017},
\]
the required remainder is

\[
\boxed{1994}.
\]
